thread.title: Special participation B: Gork on HW2
thread.content: <document version="2.0"><paragraph>For Special Participation B, I used Grok on the coding portion of HW2. Overall, I was quite satisfied with Grok’s performance. It was able to solve most problems in a one-shot manner, and only in a few cases did it modify code outside the intended TODO section. With clear instructions, those issues were easy to resolve. More details are provided in my full report attached. Here is the annotated log:</paragraph><file url="https://static.us.edusercontent.com/files/dL14li2wQXOognpRAcUDxeVd" filename="Gork--HW2.pdf"/></document>
